2. Verify webhook signatures
3. Handle relevant events
4. Update database accordingly
5. Add error handling"
user: "Review this plan"
assistant: "I'm going to use the Task tool to launch the plan-completeness-reviewer agent to thoroughly analyze this plan for gaps and completeness."
<commentary>

</commentary>
</example>

2. Add foreign key to users table
3. Migrate existing data
4. Update API endpoints
5. Deploy changes"
assistant: "Before we proceed with implementation, let me use the Task tool to launch the plan-completeness-reviewer agent to ensure this migration plan has no gaps that could cause issues during execution."

</commentary>
</example>

2. Create provider interface

4. Implement GitHub provider
5. Update frontend components
6. Test all flows"

<commentary>

</commentary>
</example>
